description:
Look up an invoice's current status. Read-only.

After an OUTCOME_UNKNOWN issuance, consult its document_id: the
dps_id of an nfse, the access_key of an nfe. A 404 on a dps_id
means nothing was issued.

access_key.description: The access key (chave de acesso) the authorizer assigned, as issue_invoice and list_invoices return it. An NF-e key has 44 characters; the issuer's CNPJ inside it may carry letters since July 2026, so copy it exactly.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit it if the connection covers a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit it if the connection covers a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

document_type.description: nfse for a service invoice, nfe for goods.

dps_id.description: nfse instead of access_key: its DPS id.

name: consult_invoice

outputSchema.description: One document, as the fiscal API describes it.

access_key.description: The authorizer's key. Absent while the document is not authorized.

id.description: Local id. Use it for reissue and for submissions, and when a document was rejected and has no key.
